verdicts.quote: A waiting member receives a confirmed booking when they become next for an available seat. No claim or response is required.

the member whose join was accepted first gets it ... the operator sees a definite order that is retained for later allocation ... Operators can inspect order but cannot use the waitlist to move an entry ahead of another.

The member gets the same cancellation effects as for an equivalent ordinary booking, including any applicable refunds, charges, and entitlement restoration. Existing rules and amounts are unconfirmed.
verdicts.missing: Whether a no-show or late cancellation of an auto-promoted booking (which the member may not have noticed) counts against the existing no-show/late-cancellation policy; no-shows are not mentioned.

verdicts.quote: After the waiting member closes the app, an eligible release can still result in a confirmed booking. The runtime's background execution rules, scheduling cadence and execution deadline are unconfirmed.
verdicts.missing: How quickly the background allocation runs after the triggering cancellation; cadence and timeliness are left unconfirmed.

verdicts.quote: If an equivalent ordinary confirmation would send a booking message, a promotion triggers the same confirmation policy. Existing channels, recipients, contents, and delivery rules are unconfirmed.
verdicts.missing: The notification channel, what the message says about the promotion, and what happens when sending fails.

verdicts.quote: With several eligible people waiting and one available seat, at most one receives a booking from that release.
If an ordinary booking and a promotion for the same member race, no second live confirmed booking is added for the member on that occurrence.
Applicable charges, credits, amounts, currency, and payment timing are unconfirmed. ... If an attempt ends without a seat after payment processing began, the member has no net charge
verdicts.missing: When payment is taken for a promoted booking, and whether a payment failure ends the wait, skips to the next member, or leaves the entry pending.

verdicts.quote: An eligible join is accepted even with many members already waiting, subject to service availability. There is no configured maximum number of waiting members per occurrence.
When ordinary booking closes, every still-waiting entry for the occurrence ends with booking closed as the reason.

Increasing capacity above occupied seats while booking remains open lets an eligible waiting member receive a booking. ... Once a lower capacity takes effect, outstanding allocations cannot create a new confirmed booking beyond it.
When the occurrence is canceled, every still-waiting entry ends with occurrence canceled as the reason.
shows the member their status as waiting, booked through the waitlist, withdrawn, or ended without booking
verdicts.missing: The entry as a record with a stored join/acceptance time, and whether queue position is stored or derived.

verdicts.quote: Exact retention duration is unconfirmed and follows the existing occurrence record lifecycle.
verdicts.missing: How long entries are kept after the class has run.

verdicts.quote: A member cannot see other entries, identities, order, or outcomes through member-facing views or requests.
verdicts.missing: Whether the member is shown their own position in the queue; the spec only says status alone suffices.

verdicts.quote: Operators cannot force a promotion through the waitlist view. ... An operator cannot use the waitlist view to withdraw one member's entry.
verdicts.missing: Whether operators see when each promotion happened; outcomes are shown without any time.

verdicts.quote: An authorized operator can pause new waitlist joins across all occurrences with one control.
No fixed waitlist-specific turnaround time is promised for this background work.
verdicts.missing: A concrete bound on how soon a promotion follows a cancellation.

verdicts.quote: A member can confirm a seat through the existing booking flow when there is capacity available for direct booking ... previously confirmed seats still appear in the member's bookings with the same active status
After enablement, an otherwise eligible full occurrence created before rollout can accept a join.
